name: The Beverage Bottler
archetype: A bottling & beverage manufacturer — brewing/blending, packaging lines, routes to market

ca.what: Food safety inspection, labelling and recall enforcement under the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations.
Food and beverage composition — permitted additives, caffeine and sweetener limits, and health claims under the Food and Drugs Act.
Environmental compliance — water use, effluent discharge and packaging stewardship obligations.

uk.what: Food safety and hygiene standards — HACCP-based controls, incident reporting and withdrawals/recalls.
Water abstraction licences, trade effluent discharge consents and waste permits for the plant.
Workplace health and safety — machinery guarding, ammonia refrigeration (COMAH) and transport safety.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Governs the company on behalf of shareholders. Approves strategy, capacity investment and the annual plan, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Compensation and Sustainability committees — the last reflecting how central water, packaging and emissions are to a bottler's licence to operate.
acc: Ultimate accountability for strategy, capital allocation and the licence to operate
Approval of major plant and line investments and the annual operating budget
Appointment, evaluation and succession of the CEO

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer
acc: Overall strategy, growth and profitability of the bottling business
Volume, revenue and share targets across brands and territories
Represents the company to brand partners, regulators and plant communities

roles.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
acc: The CEO's calendar, correspondence and briefing flow
Logistics for executive meetings, board sessions and plant visits

roles.title: VP Manufacturing & Chief Operating Officer
acc: End-to-end manufacturing performance — safety, quality, cost and service
Plant capacity strategy, capital projects and new line investments
Delivered cost per case and site OEE targets

roles.title: Plant Manager
acc: Safe, licensed operation of the site — people, product and environment
Plant output, yield and cost per case against budget

roles.title: Production Manager
acc: The production schedule and its attainment across shifts
Line efficiency (OEE), waste and changeover discipline on the filling lines

roles.title: Shift Production Supervisor
acc: Safe crewing and running of the shift across filling and packaging lines
Hourly output boards, downtime logging and start-of-shift checks

roles.title: Process Control Operator
acc: Pasteurizer, carbonation and CIP set points held within spec
Batch records and in-process checks at critical control points

roles.title: Batching & Blending Technician
acc: Syrup batching and blending to recipe — Brix, pH and carbonation targets
Traceable batch documentation and clean tank changeovers

roles.title: Bottling Line Machine Operator
acc: Filler, capper and labeller operation at rated speed
First-line changeovers, jam clearance and line-side hygiene

roles.title: Packaging & Palletizing Operator
acc: Case packing, shrink-wrapping and palletizing to load spec
Date-code legibility and finished-pallet quality

roles.title: Sanitation Technician
acc: Wash-down and CIP of lines, tanks and floors to the master sanitation schedule

roles.title: Forklift Operator

roles.title: Maintenance & Engineering Manager

roles.title: Maintenance Planner

roles.title: Industrial Mechanic (Millwright)

roles.title: Industrial Electrician

roles.title: Power Engineer — Refrigeration & Utilities

roles.title: Quality & Food Safety Manager
roles.about: Owns the food-safety and quality system with a direct escalation line to the CEO — a hold, stop-ship or recall decision cannot be overruled by production pressure.
acc: The HACCP-based food-safety and quality system across the site
Hold, release and recall decisions on every batch
Audit readiness — CFIA, FSA, GFSI and customer audits

roles.title: Food Scientist

roles.title: HACCP Coordinator

roles.title: Quality Assurance Technician

roles.title: Microbiology Lab Analyst

roles.title: Incoming Goods Quality Inspector

roles.title: VP Supply Chain
